value.description: Commercial Real Estate Careers at Fortis Net Lease Fortis Net Lease is always looking to add dedicated and talented individuals and brokers to our roster. A brokerage company is really only the sum of its brokers, and our brokers are some of the best and brightest. Interested in joining

text: Fortis Net Lease Home Our Listings About Fortis Our Success Our Team Testimonials List With FNL Careers Contact Home Our Listings About Fortis Our Success Our Team Testimonials List With FNL Careers Contact Menu Join The Team Commercial Real Estate Careers at Fortis Net Lease Fortis Net Lease is always looking to add dedicated and talented individuals and brokers to our roster. A brokerage company is really only the sum of its brokers, and our brokers are some of the best and brightest. Interested in joining the FNL Team? CURRENT CAREER OPENINGS: Associate Advisors Real Estate Interns Marketing Interns ADVISOR APPLICANT QUALITIES SOUGHT: Ability to communicate effectively and efficiently. Bachelor’s Degree or Real Estate Industry Equivalent Experience. 1 + years of experience in sales preferred, but not required. Proficient in Microsoft Office – plus ability to learn new systems Management of the complete sales cycle, including telephone prospecting, prospect nurturing and assist in sales closing Professional work ethic and integrity Competitive nature, Go – Getter Personality Ability to work well in a team environment Good organizational Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills Must be confident and comfortable with cold calling, and the cold calling process. Maintain regular contact with a large database of clients and prospects Meet and exceed assigned quotas Strong understanding of effective prospecting and proven ability to new penetrate accounts AVERAGE ADVISORS INCOME: Months 1-18: $50k-$150K Months 18-36: $150K + Months 36+: $250K + “If you have the intellect, and the work ethic, there is no limit to your earning potential. The opportunity is a gold mine; just show up with your shovel and get ready to work.” – Bryan Bender, Partner & Managing Director, Fortis Net Lease Apply Now Contact 30445 Northwestern Hwy,Suite #275Farmington Hills, MI 48334 P (248) 254-3410 F (248) 254-3405 Quicklinks Our Listings About Us Contact News Privacy Messaging Terms 2024 All Rights Reserved - Website developed by BMG Media Sign Up For Our Mailing List Broker Buyer You have subscribed successfully.
